docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A young woman of Okanagan and white descent on a Montana ranch, caught between two worlds: one of the first novels by a Native American woman.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Mourning Dove (Christine Quintasket, 1888–1936), Cogewea, the Half-Blood, 1927, with notes by Lucullus Virgil McWhorter (1860–1944). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Wikisource. Modified: converted to this format.
